segments.title: Lunchly Mold Controversy
segments.notes: Case and Pepito discuss MrBeast, Logan Paul, and KSI's Lunchly brand after YouTuber Rosanna Pansino reveals mold in the product; debate ensues over packaging failures, neon-red sauce, and whether profitability excuses safety lapses.

segments.title: Trend at the Movies: Werewolves, Munchies, Love Hurts, The Brutalist, Interior Chinatown, Creature Commandos
segments.notes: Trend (Trent) joins Case to watch seven trailers: Werewolves (2024), Munchies (1987), The Mantis (1993), Love Hurts (2025), The Brutalist (2024), Interior Chinatown (Hulu series), and Creature Commandos (animated DC series); constant bickering over pacing and werewolf taxonomy.

segments.title: Minesweeper Tutorial with Kendall
segments.notes: Kendall teaches Case and chat how to play Minesweeper, revealing her age as 30 and birthday theme '13 Going on 30'; Case struggles with logic while chat guesses her age.

segments.title: Viral Video Review with Liliana
segments.notes: Liliana joins Case for Amongst the Web: scores include zero for 'The Rizzler' Costco guys video, zero for hurricane relief content (reminded her of Rizzler), confusion over a six-year-old David clip with stolen sound effects, low score for 'Sex Is Shit' political rant, and 5.38 for Eddie Pepitone's racist mattress commercial bit.

segments.title: All Nut November Musical Finale
segments.notes: DJ Newsic performs a freestyle rap PSA promoting 'All Nut November' as a counter to No Nut November, featuring a Mr. Peanut cameo; stream ends with raid on Gina Darling.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the broadcast, hosted News and Amongst the Web segments, struggled with Minesweeper, debated trailers with Trend.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold-open sign-on, co-hosted Lunchly discussion, managed hype train interruptions.

characters.name: Trend
characters.notes: correspondent. Joined Case for 'Trend at the Movies' trailer block, bickered over pacing and werewolf definitions across seven trailers.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Taught Minesweeper tutorial, revealed age 30 and '13 Going on 30' birthday theme, declined trailer block.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-hosted Amongst the Web viral review, gave multiple zero scores, hated Rizzler-adjacent content, recognized Eddie Pepitone.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Interrupted broadcast to propose acne graphics feature, dismissed by Case.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype announcer. Summoned early, lingered through Lunchly segment, ignored Case's attempts to dismiss.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Referenced during Lunchly discussion when Case joked about 'Chetters' tuna crackers; did not appear live.

characters.name: Mr. Peanut
characters.notes: musical guest. Appeared in DJ Newsic's All Nut November finale, claimed never to miss a nut.

lore_notes.fact: Age confirmed as 30; birthday invite theme was '13 Going on 30'.
Case and Kendall have started painting their new apartment but have not yet moved in.
Delivered official station cold-open sign-on from the control room.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the Lunchly mold scandal before Trend hijacked the broadcast for a seven-trailer movie block. Kendall taught a Minesweeper masterclass revealing her thirtieth birthday, then Liliana eviscerated viral videos in Amongst the Web. DJ Newsic closed with an All Nut November anthem and a raid on Gina Darling.
